lines.en: Had the writer's money been stolen?
lines.cn: 那位作家的钱被偷了吗？

lines.en: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.
lines.cn: 我走进酒店经理的办公室，坐了下来。

lines.en: I had just lost ￡50 and I felt very upset.
lines.cn: 我刚刚损失了50英镑，感到非常沮丧。

lines.en: 'I left the money in my room,' I said, 'and it's not there now.  '
lines.cn: “我把钱放在房间里了，但现在钱不见了。”我说。

lines.en: The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing.
lines.cn: 经理很同情我，但他无能为力。

lines.en: 'Everyone's losing money these days,' he said.
He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
lines.cn: 他开始抱怨这个糟糕的世界，但这时门被敲响了。

lines.en: A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk.
lines.cn: 一个女孩走了进来，把一个信封放在他的桌子上。

lines.en: 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said.
lines.cn: “我在这位先生的房间外面发现了这个。”她说。

lines.en: 'Well,' I said to the manager,'there is still some honesty in this world!'
lines.cn: “嗯，”我对经理说，“这个世界上还是有一些诚实的人的！”
